about: What readers type into the docs search and the page that should come first, then acceptable alternatives. scripts/checks/search.mjs runs them against the built index. Tune with the tune set and check the holdout set does not get worse. An essential query must find its page first, a query with shows must have one of those pages among its results, and a set may miss no more queries than its ceiling, so an average cannot hide a query whose expected pages are missing from all its results
